implementation_policy.mercenary_policy: conservative same-family replacements first, left-to-right up to the per-commander quota; empty slots stay empty; every scenario stays within the ten-entry dynamic battle sprite cache
implementation_policy.summon_policy: Scenario 26 keeps the original formation; Scenario 27 record 0x18321A slots 4-5 replace Vampire Bat 87 with White Dragon 8F after fixed loading, ordinary movement, direct attack, and first-turn event verification
